rows.en: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for SHELTER AND SETTLEMENTS ACTORS
rows.ne: आश्रय तथा बस्तीका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूका लागि MHPSS न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेजसम्बन्धी द्रुत आरम्भ मार्गदर्शिका
rows.bt: Quick start guide on the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for shelter and settlement stakeholders
rows.note: Proposed rendering of actors: सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू; this recurring term is absent from G-0.1.

rows.section: Quick start guide to the MHPSS Minimum Service Package for SHELTER AND SETTLEMENTS ACTORS
rows.en: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.ne: मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोग न्यूनतम सेवा प्याकेज (MSP) के हो?
rows.bt: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.note: Clinical wording reuses T001 verbatim as a cited unreviewed candidate.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of emergency-affected populations.
rows.ne: MSP ले आपत्कालबाट प्रभावित जनसमुदायको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक सहयोगसम्बन्धी आवश्यकता पूरा गर्न प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to meet the mental health and psychosocial support needs of communities affected by emergencies.
rows.note: Clinical wording reuses T001 as a cited unreviewed candidate.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence, and expert consensus.
rows.ne: यो विद्यमान निर्देशिकाहरू, उपलब्ध सर्वोत्तम प्रमाण र विज्ञहरूको सहमतिमा आधारित छ।
rows.bt: It is based on existing guidelines, the best available evidence and expert consensus.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: The goal of the MSP is to contribute to reduced suffering and improved mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.ne: MSP को लक्ष्य कष्ट कम गर्न तथा मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण सुधार गर्न योगदान पुर्‍याउनु हो।
rows.bt: The aim of the MSP is to contribute to reducing distress and improving mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: The mental health and psychosocial well-being phrase reuses wording cited under T103; T005 is retained exactly. These remain unreviewed candidates. Suffering is rendered as ordinary hardship, not as a diagnosis.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: For more information on what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, please refer to the MSP guide.
rows.ne: MSP के हो, यो किन आवश्यक छ र यसलाई कसरी प्रयोग गर्न सकिन्छ भन्नेबारे थप जानकारीका लागि MSP मार्गदर्शिका हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information about what the MSP is, why it is needed and how it can be used, see the MSP guide.

rows.section: What is the Mental Health and Psychosocial Support Minimum Service Package (MSP)?
rows.en: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.ne: यो आश्रय तथा बस्तीका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूका लागि कसरी सान्दर्भिक छ?
rows.bt: How is this relevant to shelter and settlement stakeholders?
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू for the recurring term actors.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: The quality of living conditions during humanitarian crises can affect people’s physical and mental well-being as much as the initial crisis or disaster.
rows.ne: मानवीय सङ्कटहरूका बेला जीवनयापनका अवस्थाहरूको गुणस्तरले मानिसहरूको शारीरिक तथा मानसिक कल्याणमा प्रारम्भिक सङ्कट वा विपत्तिले जत्तिकै असर पार्न सक्छ।
rows.bt: During humanitarian crises, the quality of living conditions can affect people's physical and mental well-being as much as the initial crisis or disaster.
rows.note: Unvalidated practitioner draft retaining possibility and the comparison with the initial crisis or disaster.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: The stress of an emergency can be greatly compounded by:
rows.ne: निम्न अवस्थाहरूले आपत्कालका कारण हुने तनावलाई निकै बढाउन सक्छन्:
rows.bt: The following conditions can greatly increase the stress caused by emergencies:
rows.note: Stress is used here in its ordinary situational sense, not as a diagnosis or a substitute for clinical distress.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: • inadequate shelters, for example, lack of protection from the elements, poor ventilation, insufficient light or heating, or lack of safety, stability, and security;
rows.ne: • अपर्याप्त आश्रय, उदाहरणका लागि, प्रतिकूल मौसमी अवस्थाबाट संरक्षणको अभाव, हावा आवतजावतको कमजोर व्यवस्था, अपर्याप्त प्रकाश वा न्यानो बनाउने व्यवस्था, वा सुरक्षित अवस्था, स्थिरता र सुरक्षाको अभाव;
rows.bt: • Inadequate shelter, for example, lack of protection from adverse weather conditions, poor ventilation arrangements, inadequate lighting or heating arrangements, or lack of safe conditions, stability and security;
rows.note: Safety and security are both retained rather than collapsed into a single item. Security was replaced by protective arrangements, which describes measures rather than security itself. The revision retains safety, stability and security as three separate items.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: • overcrowding in collective sites, settlements or underserviced neighbourhoods;
rows.ne: • सामूहिक बसोबास स्थल, बस्ती वा सेवा अपर्याप्त भएका टोलहरूमा अत्यधिक भीडभाड;
rows.bt: • Excessive crowding in collective living sites, settlements or neighborhoods with inadequate services;

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: • inadequate access to basic services within shelters, including cooking and washing facilities, menstrual hygiene management, waste management, electricity, and water supply.
rows.ne: • आश्रयभित्र खाना पकाउने र धुने सुविधा, महिनावारी स्वच्छता व्यवस्थापन, फोहोर व्यवस्थापन, विद्युत् र पानी आपूर्तिलगायत आधारभूत सेवामा अपर्याप्त पहुँच।
rows.bt: • Inadequate access to basic services within the shelter, including cooking and washing facilities, menstrual hygiene management, waste management, electricity and water supply.
rows.note: The source says water supply, not drinking water supply. Removed the added restriction to drinking water.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: Shelter and Settlements actors can play a key role in enhancing well-being by providing adequate shelter, creating a safe and healthy living environment, reducing health risks, and promoting mental health as well as physical health.
rows.ne: आश्रय तथा बस्तीका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले पर्याप्त आश्रय उपलब्ध गराएर, सुरक्षित र स्वस्थ बसोबासको वातावरण सिर्जना गरेर, स्वास्थ्य जोखिम घटाएर तथा शारीरिक स्वास्थ्यका साथै मानसिक स्वास्थ्य प्रवर्द्धन गरेर कल्याण बढाउन महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: Shelter and settlement stakeholders can play an important role in increasing well-being by providing adequate shelter, creating safe and healthy living environments, reducing health risks and promoting mental health as well as physical health.
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of actors. Mental health wording is reused from the cited unreviewed T103 candidate; no new clinical intervention wording is introduced.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: The MSP outlines priority activities that Shelter and Settlements actors can contribute to in order to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people living in emergency or transitional shelters.
rows.ne: MSP ले आपत्कालीन वा सङ्क्रमणकालीन आश्रयमा बस्ने व्यक्तिहरूको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न आश्रय तथा बस्तीका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले योगदान दिन सक्ने प्राथमिकताका गतिविधिहरूको रूपरेखा प्रस्तुत गर्छ।
rows.bt: The MSP outlines priority activities to which shelter and settlement stakeholders can contribute to promote the mental health and psychosocial well-being of people living in emergency or transitional shelters.
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of actors. The mental health and psychosocial well-being phrase reuses cited unreviewed wording under T103, including the exact T005 candidate.

rows.section: How is it relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.ne: MSP मा आश्रय तथा बस्तीसम्बन्धी सामग्री कसरी फेला पार्ने?
rows.bt: How to find shelter- and settlement-related material in the MSP?

rows.section: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.en: Each MSP activity is labelled with icons showing which sectors, clusters, or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are typically well placed to deliver it (colourful icons) or contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.ne: प्रत्येक MSP गतिविधिमा प्रतीकचिह्न राखिएका छन्, जसले कुन क्षेत्र, क्लस्टर वा जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्र (AoRs) सामान्यतया उक्त गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (रङ्गीन प्रतीकचिह्न) वा त्यसमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा छन् (गाढा निलो प्रतीकचिह्न) भन्ने देखाउँछन्।1
rows.bt: Each MSP activity has icons that show which sectors, clusters or areas of responsibility (AoRs) are generally well placed to carry out that activity (colored icons) or well placed to contribute to it (dark blue icons).1
rows.note: Proposed missing terminology: icons = प्रतीकचिह्न; areas of responsibility = जिम्मेवारीका क्षेत्र; clusters = क्लस्टर. The footnote marker 1 and acronym AoRs are retained.

rows.section: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark-blue Shelter and Settlements icon indicates that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well-placed to contribute to the implementation of a given activity.
rows.ne: आश्रय तथा बस्तीको गाढा निलो प्रतीकचिह्नले आश्रय तथा बस्तीका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया कुनै निर्दिष्ट गतिविधिको कार्यान्वयनमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने जनाउँछ।
rows.bt: The dark blue shelter and settlement icon indicates that shelter and settlement stakeholders are generally well placed to contribute to the implementation of a specified activity.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of icons and actors, both absent from G-0.1.

rows.section: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.en: For more information, see Who should implement MSP activities?
rows.ne: थप जानकारीका लागि ‘MSP गतिविधि कसले कार्यान्वयन गर्नुपर्छ?’ हेर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: For more information, see ‘Who should implement MSP activities?’

rows.section: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.en: Figure 1 shows activity 3.6, Provide group activities for children´s mental health and psychosocial well-being, as an example.
rows.ne: चित्र 1 मा उदाहरणका रूपमा गतिविधि 3.6, ‘बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने’, देखाइएको छ।
rows.bt: Figure 1 shows activity 3.6, ‘Providing group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being’, as an example.
rows.note: The complete activity label reuses T103 verbatim as a cited unreviewed candidate. Figure and activity numbers are retained.

rows.section: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.en: The colourful icons show that Education and Child Protection actors are typically well placed to deliver this activity.
rows.ne: रङ्गीन प्रतीकचिह्नहरूले शिक्षा र बाल संरक्षणका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यो गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The colored icons show that education and child protection stakeholders are generally well placed to carry out this activity.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of icons and actors.

rows.section: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.en: The dark blue icons show that Camp Coordination and Camp Management (CCCM), Shelter and Settlements, and WASH actors are typically well placed to contribute this activity.
rows.ne: गाढा निलो प्रतीकचिह्नहरूले शिविर समन्वय तथा शिविर व्यवस्थापन (CCCM), आश्रय तथा बस्ती, र WASH का सम्बद्ध पक्षहरू सामान्यतया यस गतिविधिमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन् भन्ने देखाउँछन्।
rows.bt: The dark blue icons show that camp coordination and camp management (CCCM), shelter and settlement, and WASH stakeholders are generally well placed to contribute to this activity.
rows.note: Uses proposed renderings of icons and actors. CCCM and WASH are retained exactly.

rows.section: How do I find Shelter and Settlements content in the MSP?
rows.en: For example, Shelter and Settlements actors may provide the space in which to conduct the activity and may have an important role in informing the community about when and where these activities will take place.
rows.ne: उदाहरणका लागि, आश्रय तथा बस्तीका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूले गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्ने स्थान उपलब्ध गराउन सक्छन् र यी गतिविधिहरू कहिले र कहाँ सञ्चालन हुनेछन् भन्नेबारे समुदायलाई जानकारी दिन महत्त्वपूर्ण भूमिका खेल्न सक्छन्।
rows.bt: For example, shelter and settlement stakeholders can provide a place to carry out activities and can play an important role in informing the community about when and where these activities will take place.
rows.note: Uses the proposed rendering of actors. Both possibilities expressed by may are retained.

rows.section: Which MSP activities are most relevant to Shelter and Settlements actors?
rows.en: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.ne: खण्ड 1: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय र लेखाजोखा
rows.bt: Section 1: Inter-agency coordination and assessment
rows.note: Proposed rendering of the recurring technical phrase inter-agency coordination: अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant for coordination groups in all sectors and AoRs, and cross-cutting MHPSS technical working groups.
rows.ne: गतिविधि 1.1 र 1.2 सबै क्षेत्र र AoRs का समन्वय समूहहरू तथा विभिन्न क्षेत्रलाई समेट्ने MHPSS प्राविधिक कार्यसमूहहरू (Technical Working Groups) का लागि विशेष रूपमा सान्दर्भिक छन्।
rows.bt: Activities 1.1 and 1.2 are particularly relevant to coordination groups of all sectors and AoRs and MHPSS technical working groups (Technical Working Groups) covering different sectors.
rows.note: AoRs recurs without a supplied glossary entry; its proposed Nepali expansion appears in row QSG-SHE-0016. The English expansion accompanies the first use of the T050 label. Codes 1.1 and 1.2 are unchanged.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: They promote effective inter-agency and intersectoral coordination and assessment.
rows.ne: यी गतिविधिहरूले प्रभावकारी अन्तरनिकाय तथा अन्तरक्षेत्रीय समन्वय र लेखाजोखालाई प्रवर्द्धन गर्छन्।
rows.bt: These activities promote effective inter-agency and inter-sectoral coordination and assessment.
rows.note: Uses the proposed recurring phrase अन्तरनिकाय समन्वय; intersectoral coordination is rendered as अन्तरक्षेत्रीय समन्वय.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within and across sectors
rows.ne: 1.1 क्षेत्रभित्र र क्षेत्रहरूबीच MHPSS समन्वय गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.1 Coordinate MHPSS within the sector and between sectors.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity-label candidate for 1.1.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Establishing communication between MHPSS TWG and Shelter cluster, e.g. information sharing and discussions of areas for potential collaboration.
rows.ne: MHPSS TWG र आश्रय क्लस्टरबीच सञ्चार स्थापित गर्ने, उदाहरणका लागि सूचना आदानप्रदान गर्ने र सम्भावित सहकार्यका क्षेत्रबारे छलफल गर्ने।
rows.bt: Establish communication between the MHPSS TWG and the shelter cluster, for example by exchanging information and discussing potential areas of collaboration.
rows.note: TWG is retained without an unsupported expansion.

rows.ne: 1.2 कार्यक्रमलाई दिशा दिन MHPSS आवश्यकता र स्रोतहरूको लेखाजोखा गर्ने।
rows.bt: 1.2 Assess MHPSS needs and resources to guide the programme.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity-label candidate for 1.2.

rows.section: Section 1: Inter-Agency Coordination and Assessment
rows.en: Including MHPSS in Shelter needs assessments.

rows.bt: Include MHPSS when assessing shelter-related needs.

rows.bt: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.note: This is a section heading, not an individual activity label.

rows.section: Section 2: Essential components of all MHPSS programmes
rows.en: Section 2 activities (on programme design, implementing an M&E system, caring for staff and volunteers and supporting MHPSS competencies) should be implemented by all organizations delivering MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: MHPSS गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्ने सबै संस्थाले खण्ड 2 का गतिविधिहरू कार्यान्वयन गर्नु उचित हुन्छ। यी गतिविधिहरू कार्यक्रमको डिजाइन गर्ने, अनुगमन तथा मूल्याङ्कन (M&E) प्रणाली कार्यान्वयन गर्ने, कर्मचारी र स्वयंसेवकको हेरचाह गर्ने तथा MHPSS सक्षमतामा सहयोग गर्नेसम्बन्धी छन्।
rows.bt: It is appropriate for all organizations conducting MHPSS activities to implement the activities in Section 2. These activities concern designing programmes, implementing monitoring and evaluation (M&E) systems, caring for staff and volunteers, and supporting MHPSS competencies.
rows.note: M&E and competency wording draws on the supplied activity-list candidates for 2.2 and 2.4. The back-translation strengthens 'should' to 'must' and restricts MHPSS competencies to those of staff and volunteers by adding 'their'; the source does neither.

rows.section: Sections 3 & 4: MHPSS Programme Activities
rows.en: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.ne: आश्रय तथा बस्ती क्षेत्रका कर्ताहरू सामान्यतया निम्न कार्यक्रमगत गतिविधिहरूमा योगदान दिन उपयुक्त स्थितिमा हुन्छन्:
rows.bt: Actors in the shelter and settlement sector are generally well placed to contribute to the following programme activities:

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS considerations and actions
rows.ne: 3.1 मानवीय कर्ता र समुदायका सदस्यलाई MHPSS बारे अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने र MHPSS सम्बन्धी विचारणीय पक्ष तथा कार्यका लागि पैरवी गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.1 Orient humanitarian actors and community members on MHPSS and advocate for MHPSS-related considerations and actions.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity-label candidate for 3.1.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Collaborating with MHPSS experts to orient Shelter and Settlements actors on MHPSS and interlinkages between MHPSS and Shelter and Settlements programming. Providing Shelter and Settlements programming in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being. For example: by promoting community participation in assessments, programme planning, and implementation; enabling people to choose their shelter arrangements, where possible; providing adequate, socially acceptable shelter and settlements; using familiar and locally-available construction materials; providing culturally appropriate household items; promoting and facilitating homemaking activities such as gardening, decoration, “personalization”; and promoting cash for work and activities that support the local economy and the livelihoods of affected communities. Supporting community-led repair and/or (re)construction of homes to promote a sense of agency and dignity. Ensuring that Shelter activities and services are accessible to and consider the specific needs of people with mental health conditions.
rows.ne: MHPSS तथा MHPSS र आश्रय तथा बस्तीसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयनबीचका अन्तरसम्बन्धहरूबारे आश्रय तथा बस्ती क्षेत्रका सम्बद्ध पक्षहरूको अभिमुखीकरण गर्न MHPSS विशेषज्ञहरूसँग सहकार्य गर्नुहोस्। मानसिक स्वास्थ्य र मनोसामाजिक कल्याणलाई सहयोग पुग्ने तरिकाले आश्रय तथा बस्तीसम्बन्धी कार्यक्रम तर्जुमा तथा कार्यान्वयन गर्नुहोस्। उदाहरणका लागि: लेखाजोखा, कार्यक्रम योजना र कार्यान्वयनमा समुदायको सहभागिता प्रवर्द्धन गर्नुहोस्; सम्भव भएसम्म मानिसहरूलाई आफ्नो आश्रयको व्यवस्था रोज्न सक्षम बनाउनुहोस्; पर्याप्त र सामाजिक रूपमा स्वीकार्य आश्रय तथा बस्ती उपलब्ध गराउनुहोस्; चिरपरिचित र स्थानीय रूपमा उपलब्ध निर्माण सामग्री प्रयोग गर्नुहोस्; सांस्कृतिक रूपमा उपयुक्त घरायसी सामग्री उपलब्ध गराउनुहोस्; बगैँचा बनाउने, सजावट गर्ने र घरलाई “व्यक्तिगत रुचिअनुसार बनाउने” जस्ता घर व्यवस्थित गर्ने गतिविधिहरू प्रवर्द्धन गर्नुका साथै तिनलाई सहज बनाउनुहोस्; अनि कामको बदलामा नगद दिने व्यवस्था तथा स्थानीय अर्थतन्त्र र प्रभावित समुदायहरूको जीविकोपार्जनमा सहयोग पुर्‍याउने गतिविधिहरू प्रवर्द्धन गर्नुहोस्। आफ्नो निर्णयअनुसार काम गर्न सक्ने अनुभूति र मर्यादाको भावना बढाउन घरहरूको मर्मत र/वा (पुनः)निर्माणका समुदायको नेतृत्वमा सञ्चालित कार्यहरूलाई सहयोग गर्नुहोस्। आश्रयसम्बन्धी गतिविधि र सेवाहरू मानसिक स्वास्थ्यसम्बन्धी अवस्था भएका व्यक्तिहरूका लागि पहुँचयोग्य भएको र तिनले ती व्यक्तिहरूका विशिष्ट आवश्यकताहरूलाई ध्यानमा राखेको सुनिश्चित गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Collaborate with MHPSS specialists to orient stakeholders in the shelter and settlement sector about MHPSS and the interrelationships between MHPSS and shelter and settlement programme design and implementation. Design and implement shelter and settlement programmes in ways that support mental health and psychosocial well-being. For example: promote community participation in assessment, programme planning and implementation; enable people to choose their shelter arrangements as far as possible; provide adequate and socially acceptable shelter and settlements; use familiar and locally available construction materials; provide culturally appropriate household materials; promote and facilitate activities for arranging the home, such as gardening, decorating and making the home “according to personal preferences”; and promote cash-for-work arrangements and activities that support the local economy and the livelihoods of affected communities. Support community-led efforts to repair and/or (re)construct homes to increase the sense of being able to act according to one's own decisions and the sense of dignity. Ensure that shelter activities and services are accessible to people with mental health conditions and that they take those people's specific needs into account.
rows.note: Unvalidated practitioner draft retaining the conditional shelter choice, community-led work, and the population with mental health conditions without adding distress or impaired functioning. The supplied BT preserves the intended meaning, but the Nepali places the community-led modifier directly before homes, allowing it to describe the homes rather than their repair and/or (re)construction. Repaired that modifier relationship while retaining the frozen form.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills
rows.ne: 3.2 अग्रपंक्तिका कार्यकर्ता र सामुदायिक अगुवालाई आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग सीपमा अभिमुखीकरण गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.2 Orient frontline workers and community leaders in basic psychosocial support skills.
rows.note: The psychosocial-support wording is reused from the cited unreviewed T099 activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Organizing orientations on basic psychosocial support (e.g. psychological first aid), for Shelter workers, including the identification and referral of children and adults who may need MHPSS services and supports.
rows.ne: MHPSS सेवा तथा सहयोग आवश्यक पर्न सक्ने बालबालिका र वयस्कहरूको पहिचान तथा तिनलाई सम्बन्धित सेवामा पठाउने कार्यसमेत समेटी, आश्रय क्षेत्रमा काम गर्ने कर्मचारीहरूका लागि आधारभूत मनोसामाजिक सहयोग (जस्तै, [psychological first aid]) सम्बन्धी अभिमुखीकरणहरू आयोजना गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Organize orientations on basic psychosocial support (e.g., [psychological first aid]) for staff working in the shelter sector, also including the identification of children and adults who may need MHPSS services and support and their referral to relevant services.
rows.note: Unvalidated practitioner draft retaining the exact English intervention name and the possibility that children and adults may need services and support.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.3 मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याण प्रवर्द्धन गर्न मुख्य सन्देशहरू प्रसार गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.3 Disseminate key messages to promote mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Uses the cited unreviewed T100 activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Incorporating key MHPSS messages into Shelter activities and informational materials.
rows.ne: आश्रयसम्बन्धी गतिविधि र सूचनामूलक सामग्रीमा MHPSS का मुख्य सन्देशहरू समावेश गर्ने।
rows.bt: Include key MHPSS messages in shelter-related activities and informational materials.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.4 Support new and pre-existing group-based community MHPSS activities
rows.ne: 3.4 नयाँ तथा पहिलेदेखि सञ्चालित समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिलाई सहयोग गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.4 Support new and already operating group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.note: Uses the supplied activity-label candidate for 3.4.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Engaging residents (where possible) in the selection and design of communal spaces for group-based community MHPSS activities, and social, cultural, religious, educational, and information-sharing activities (e.g. markets, schools, places of worship, community centres, recreational areas). Designing shelters in ways that promote social support (e.g. by integrating traditional positioning of neighbouring houses, avoiding separating people who wish to be together).
rows.ne: समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिहरू तथा सामाजिक, सांस्कृतिक, धार्मिक, शैक्षिक र सूचना आदानप्रदानसम्बन्धी गतिविधिका लागि सामुदायिक स्थलहरू (जस्तै बजार, विद्यालय, उपासनास्थल, सामुदायिक केन्द्र र मनोरञ्जन क्षेत्र) छनोट गर्ने र तिनको डिजाइन तयार गर्ने कार्यमा सम्भव भएसम्म बासिन्दाहरूलाई संलग्न गराउने। सामाजिक सहयोग प्रवर्द्धन हुने गरी आश्रयको डिजाइन तयार गर्ने, उदाहरणका लागि छिमेकी घरहरू राख्ने परम्परागत ढाँचा समावेश गर्ने र सँगै रहन चाहने व्यक्तिहरूलाई अलग नगर्ने।
rows.bt: Involve residents as far as possible in selecting and designing community spaces (such as markets, schools, places of worship, community centres and recreational areas) for group-based community MHPSS activities and activities related to social, cultural, religious, educational and information exchange matters. Design shelters in a way that promotes social support, for example by incorporating traditional patterns of placing neighbouring houses and not separating people who want to stay together.
rows.note: 'Wish to live together' narrows 'wish to be together' to a residential arrangement; the source also covers keeping people together without requiring shared residence.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Maintaining safe and accessible spaces in which to conduct group-based community MHPSS activities. Communicating with residents about the timings and locations of group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.ne: समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिहरू सञ्चालन गर्न सुरक्षित र पहुँचयोग्य स्थलहरू कायम राख्ने। समूहमा आधारित सामुदायिक MHPSS गतिविधिहरूको समय र स्थानबारे बासिन्दाहरूसँग सञ्चार गर्ने।
rows.bt: Maintain safe and accessible spaces for conducting group-based community MHPSS activities. Communicate with residents about the times and locations of group-based community MHPSS activities.
rows.note: General safety guidance drafted; review pending. Accessibility is not reduced to proximity.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.6 Provide group activities for children’s mental health and psychosocial well-being
rows.ne: 3.6 बालबालिकाको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.6 Provide group activities for children's mental health and psychosocial well-being.
rows.note: Uses the cited unreviewed T103 activity-label candidate.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Engaging residents (where possible) in the selection and design of spaces for structured and recreational group activities for the mental health and psychosocial well-being of children and adolescents. Supporting the maintenance of safe and accessible spaces in which to conduct group activities for children and adolescents. Communicating with residents about the timings and locations of available group activities for children and adolescents.
rows.ne: बालबालिका तथा किशोरकिशोरीको मानसिक स्वास्थ्य तथा मनोसामाजिक कल्याणका लागि संरचित र मनोरञ्जनात्मक सामूहिक गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्ने स्थलहरूको छनोट र डिजाइनमा सम्भव भएसम्म बासिन्दाहरूलाई संलग्न गराउने। बालबालिका तथा किशोरकिशोरीका लागि सामूहिक गतिविधि सञ्चालन गर्न सुरक्षित र पहुँचयोग्य स्थलहरू कायम राख्ने कार्यमा सहयोग गर्ने। बालबालिका तथा किशोरकिशोरीका लागि उपलब्ध सामूहिक गतिविधिहरूको समय र स्थानबारे बासिन्दाहरूसँग सञ्चार गर्ने।
rows.bt: Involve residents as far as possible in selecting and designing spaces for conducting structured and recreational group activities for the mental health and psychosocial well-being of children and adolescents. Support the work of maintaining safe and accessible spaces for conducting group activities for children and adolescents. Communicate with residents about the times and locations of group activities available for children and adolescents.
rows.note: General safety guidance drafted; review pending. The mental-health and psychosocial-well-being phrase is reused from cited unreviewed T100 and T103 wording; no clinical intervention wording is introduced.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through women and girls safe spaces
rows.ne: 3.9 महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमार्फत MHPSS प्रदान गर्ने।
rows.bt: 3.9 Provide MHPSS through safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.
rows.note: The frozen T106 activity label, incorporating T054, specifies women and adolescent girls, whereas the source includes girls without an adolescent-only restriction; the required frozen wording therefore excludes younger girls. bt-divergence: The frozen T106 activity label, incorporating T054, restricts girls to adolescent girls; the source does not impose that age restriction. The required frozen wording is retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: Engaging residents, especially girls and women, in decision making related to the selection and design of safe spaces for women and girls. Supporting the maintenance of safe and accessible spaces for women and girls. Communicating with residents about the timings and locations of MHPSS activities at safe spaces for women and girls.
rows.ne: महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलको छनोट र डिजाइनसम्बन्धी निर्णय प्रक्रियामा बासिन्दाहरूलाई, विशेषगरी बालिका र महिलाहरूलाई, सहभागी गराउनुहोस्। महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थल सुरक्षित र पहुँचयोग्य रहने गरी त्यसको मर्मतसम्भारमा सहयोग गर्नुहोस्। महिला तथा किशोरीका लागि सुरक्षित स्थलमा हुने MHPSS गतिविधिहरूका समय र स्थानबारे बासिन्दाहरूसँग जानकारी आदानप्रदान गर्नुहोस्।
rows.bt: Involve residents, especially girls and women, in the decision-making process concerning the selection and design of safe spaces for women and adolescent girls. Support the maintenance of safe spaces for women and adolescent girls so that they remain safe and accessible. Exchange information with residents about the times and locations of MHPSS activities taking place in safe spaces for women and adolescent girls.
rows.note: The frozen T054 safe-space label specifies women and adolescent girls, whereas the source includes girls without an age restriction; the participation phrase retains girls generally, but the required safe-space label excludes younger girls. bt-divergence: The frozen T054 label restricts the safe spaces to women and adolescent girls, whereas the source includes girls without an adolescent-only restriction. The participation phrase retains girls generally. The required frozen label is retained.

rows.section: The programmatic activities that Shelter and Settlements actors are typically well placed to contribute to are:
rows.en: You can use the filter on the ‘All Activities’ page of the web platform to show only Shelter and Settlements-relevant activities.
rows.ne: आश्रय तथा बस्तीसँग सम्बन्धित गतिविधिहरू मात्र देखाउन तपाईंले वेब प्लेटफर्मको ‘सबै गतिविधिहरू’ (‘All Activities’) पृष्ठमा रहेको फिल्टर प्रयोग गर्न सक्नुहुन्छ।
rows.bt: You can use the filter on the web platform's ‘All Activities’ (‘All Activities’) page to show only activities related to shelter and settlements.
rows.note: The English page label is retained to support navigation.

rows.en: For help navigating the MSP, see How is the MSP Structured? and the video tour of the web platform.
